title.narrative: Supporting Agreements for Peace and a Resumption of the Political Process in Yemen - Peace Building Fund

description.narrative: UNOPS supports the UN Special Envoy’s efforts to reach credible and sustainable agreements aimed at ending the conflict in Yemen and allowing for the resumption of a peaceful, inclusive, orderly and Yemeni-led political transition process that meets the legitimate demands and aspirations of the Yemeni people. Activities will 1) support the operational and logistical requirements to conduct negotiations aimed at reaching a negotiated political settlement aimed at ending the conflict; and 2) provide technical advice to mediation teams and the conflict parties to strengthen negotiation capacities and assist in development of conflict-ending proposals. \nThe intended results of this project are: a) The resumption of peace and political negotiations in Yemen; b) Development of credible proposals addressing major points of contention in the conflict; c) Support for a political settlement, the resumption of an inclusive national dialogue, and a sustained and peaceful political transition.\n
